## Description

Detail panel actions with state rules: Check in (only Booked), Reschedule (not Completed), Cancel (asks reason; not Completed/Cancelled), Mark no-show (only Booked). Drag-and-drop reschedule asks for confirmation and uses the same booking concurrency path. No-show offers "Rebook" which opens booking with the patient preselected. Reschedule/cancel notify the patient (MDV-P1-032).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Disallowed actions are disabled with an explanation and rejected by the API if called.
- [ ] **AC2.** Cancel without a reason is impossible; reasons are a short list + free text.
- [ ] **AC3.** A reschedule keeps history (old slot, new slot, actor, time) and frees the old slot atomically.
- [ ] **AC4.** No-show offers rebook and is counted in the no-show metric (MDV-P1-041).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
